surface: src/plate_core/data/baseline_catalog.yml, agents_surface renderer, plugin agent personas
summary: Add narrow crew roles to the baseline catalog with per-role skills, default MCP tool profiles, generated plugin personas, and label-based role inference.
migration_impact: Downstream repos that mirror the baseline catalog gain additional agent ids and must regenerate plugin agent surfaces after import. No new GitHub role labels are introduced.
migration_guidance: 1. After upgrading plate-core, run `python3 scripts/generate-plugin-agents.py` if you vendor plugin agent files.
2. Task specs may reference new baseline agent ids (for example team-lead, product-manager, go-to-market-lead).
3. Role routing from issues continues to use issue type plus existing labels; do not add role:* labels.
agent_notes: Use `gh plate agents list` to discover new roles. Each catalog agent declares `default_tool_profiles` for MCP hosts (see docs/mcp.md). The hand-authored `plate` coordinator persona is unchanged.
